liu_jssc_2025.citation: J. Liu et al., 'A High-Accuracy and Ultra-Energy-Efficient Cardiac Arrhythmia Classification Processor for Wearable Intelligent ECG Monitoring,' IEEE JSSC, 2025. DOI: 10.1109/JSSC.2025.3555512
liu_jssc_2025.energy: 90 nJ (processor only — feature extraction + NN inference. Does NOT include AFE: IA, filters, ADC)
liu_jssc_2025.technique: Event-driven NN, shared feature extraction (60.5% MAC reduction), adaptive NN wake-up
liu_jssc_2025.comparison_notes: Their 90nJ excludes AFE. Our full-chain target includes AFE. Like-for-like (classifier+features only), our target is ~3-10nJ MLP, well below their 90nJ.

cao_biocas_2023.citation: T. Cao et al., 'ECG Classification using Binary CNN on RRAM Crossbar with Nonidealities-Aware Training, Readout Compensation and CWT Preprocessing,' IEEE BioCAS 2023. DOI: 10.1109/BioCAS58349.2023.10389002
cao_biocas_2023.accuracy: 98.9% on MIT-BIH (10-class), only 0.7% drop from FP32 baseline
cao_biocas_2023.technique: Non-ideality-aware training, in-situ readout compensation for IR drop, binary weights, CWT preprocessing
cao_biocas_2023.comparison_notes: Intra-patient only. Binary CNN not SNN. CWT features vs our cardiologist-curated. Unspecified RRAM vs our foundry PDK.

our_novelty_claims: First ECG classifier on a foundry ReRAM PDK (all prior memristor-ECG work uses lab devices or idealized models)
Full-chain energy including AFE (most competitors exclude analog frontend cost)
ADC-free fully-analog pipeline (electrodes to classification without any digital conversion)
